name: GPT-1
notes: Research publication and downloadable model. Historically called GPT, now commonly GPT-1.

name: GPT-2 124M
notes: First small checkpoint; originally described as 117M, corrected to 124M. The 1.5B model was not released on this date.

name: GPT-2 355M
notes: Official commit: updates for 345M model. Parameter count later corrected to 355M.

name: GPT-2 1.5B
notes: Final staged release; do not use the February announcement date.

name: GPT-3
notes: API private beta with applications for access. The research paper was published May 28; no claim of unrestricted availability.

name: Codex (2021)
notes: First access through GitHub Copilot technical preview; the updated Codex API beta followed August 10.

name: GPT-3.5 (ChatGPT)
notes: First public ChatGPT research preview based on GPT-3.5; this is not a claim that earlier GPT-3.5 API ancestors first appeared on this date.

name: GPT-3.5 Turbo
notes: Original date confirmed by the OpenAI staff announcement: https://community.openai.com/t/introducing-chatgpt-and-whisper-apis/80485 . The blog header now shows an April 24, 2024 edit.

name: Claude 1
notes: Broader customer launch after closed partner alpha.

name: Claude Instant 1
notes: Broader customer launch after closed partner alpha.

name: GPT-4
notes: ChatGPT Plus access and API waitlist. GPT-4 32k is not counted separately without a separately verified first-availability day.

name: GPT-3.5 Turbo 16k
notes: New named longer-context variant; routine 0613 snapshots are not separate entries.

name: GPT-4 Turbo
notes: Public API preview; later GA and routine snapshots are not additional entries.

name: Claude 3.5 Sonnet
notes: Availability notice: June 20. The current announcement page displays June 21; the API release notes explicitly confirm availability on June 20.

name: o1-mini
notes: Public preview; not the December o1 release.

name: o1-preview
notes: Public preview; not the December o1 release.

name: Claude 3.5 Sonnet v2
notes: Explicitly announced new revision under the same family name; can be excluded.

name: Claude 3.5 Haiku
notes: October 22 was the announcement. API availability began November 4.

name: o1
notes: First customer availability in ChatGPT; December 17 was API availability. Pro mode is not a separate entry.

name: GPT-4.5
notes: Public research preview.

name: codex-1
notes: Named coding models; separate from the Codex application. Public preview.

name: codex-mini
notes: Named coding models; separate from the Codex application. Public preview.

name: GPT-5
notes: Canonical named model entries; ChatGPT routing labels and Pro compute modes are not additional releases.

name: GPT-5 mini
notes: Canonical named model entries; ChatGPT routing labels and Pro compute modes are not additional releases.

name: GPT-5 nano
notes: Canonical named model entries; ChatGPT routing labels and Pro compute modes are not additional releases.

name: GPT-5-Codex
notes: Available in Codex September 15; API September 23.

name: GPT-5.1
notes: First ChatGPT rollout. Instant/Thinking/Pro product modes are not counted separately in this catalogue.

name: GPT-5.1-Codex-Max
notes: A separately named trained model, not the Max effort setting. API followed December 4.

name: GPT-5.2
notes: Instant/Thinking/Pro modes grouped as one named version, consistently with GPT-5.1.

name: GPT-5.2-Codex
notes: Codex availability; API followed January 14, 2026.

name: GPT-5.3-Codex
notes: Codex availability; API followed February 24.

name: GPT-5.3-Codex-Spark
notes: Research preview for Pro subscribers.

name: GPT-5.5
notes: First customer availability; API April 24.
